series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

dispositions.note: Sentence-final items are decided by a stated, neutral rule (keep the style of the surrounding text) plus a visible 【報告】／【作文】／【お知らせ】／【スピーチ】 frame and a second sentence in plain or polite style; だ is not offered because it would also fit plain contexts. One item (old-school-building) is decided by grammar: Nであること inside a polite sentence. The two です items are jlpt 3 because the visible choice includes the N3 form である.

dispositions.note: Interpretation: 強調 (exclamatory ことか) versus 質問 (embedded question with か followed by 教えてください or 聞かれた). Selection between ことか and plain か was rejected because an exclamatory どれほど…か／だろう is also acceptable, and …かわからない is avoided because it is itself an emphatic idiom. The two 質問 items are jlpt 3 because the task is the N3 ことか contrast; embedded か is not a row owned by another set.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3 (ずに); Bunpro N4 (ないで); Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Two task types: a named conversion between ないで and ずに (including する → せずに and back), and the written ず link chosen by polarity (何も／一度も cues). Selection between ずに and ないで was rejected because both are correct for 'without'; selection between ずに and なくて was rejected because causal ず(に) is also common in writing. The ないで targets are jlpt 3 because the conversion requires the N3 form ずに. time-linking covers ないで/なくて at N4 and is linked as next.

groups.reason: Selection between two given forms; no form from another group must be produced.
The base verb is supplied with its reading; stem and ない forms are N5 knowledge.
Conversion from a printed form; time-linking negative groups are recommended, not required.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: CLEAN after reconciliation; one medium finding declined by the coordinator

findings.claim: The prompt 予約____店に行った made 予約せずに equally natural, so the ないで key was not decidable.
findings.change: The slot now replaces the whole verb (____店に行った); answers 予約しないで／よやくしないで, and the distractor is labelled 予約せずに; vocabulary segments regenerated.

findings.claim: The kanji spellings 云わず／云わずに were not accepted.
findings.change: Accepted answers now include 云わず and 云わずに.

findings.claim: The spelling 遣わず should be accepted.
findings.change: Not adopted: 遣う does not cover using a dictionary in this sense.

findings.claim: The rule 'drop ない, add ずに' gave wrong forms for the irregular verbs.
findings.change: The rule now names the irregulars: する → せずに (not しずに), 来る → 来ずに（こずに）.

findings.claim: The っけ attachment rule was oversimplified.
findings.change: Nouns and な-adjectives take だっけ／だったっけ; verbs commonly take たっけ or んだっけ／のだっけ; a だったっけ example for a past state was added.

findings.claim: Same as WRN-A-01: ないで and せずに were both natural in the old frame.
Instructions listed the candidate forms, so the instruction itself gave away the style choice.
findings.change: Instructions now say the answer 'keeps the style (plain or polite) of the text around it'.

findings.claim: でもある was only practised after an affirmative clause.
findings.change: Added a でもある item after a negative clause (key rewarding-job); the next sentence is the deciding cue.

findings.claim: The rule-in-effect reading of となっている had only a polite example.
findings.change: Added a plain-style rule item with 決まり (key entry-age-rule).

findings.claim: The change reading lacked a result-of-event cue.
findings.change: Prompt rewritten around 値段が下がった結果; article §3 and ledger note updated.

findings.claim: The ledger note claimed ichidan coverage that the items do not test.
findings.change: Note now reads: godan (洗い, 会い) and する → し; no ichidan base tested.

findings.claim: Same as WRN-A-01: the learner could not tell which of two natural answers was wanted.
百年前の学校 read as a school that existed a century ago, not an old building.
findings.change: Now 市で一番古い学校____こと, 'is the oldest school in the city'; vocabulary and the article sentence updated.

findings.claim: Same as WRN-A-05: learners could not form っけ correctly from the article.
